design_overview: Add --compare-run to CLI, extend ExampleLifecycleRecord with comparison fields, add compare_with_prior_run() to ExampleLifecycleRegistry, integrate into runner after lifecycle evidence is written.

cli_behavior.help_text: Compare current run results against a prior run to detect regressions

when_provided.1: After lifecycle evidence is written, load prior run lifecycle from workspace/runs/{prior_run_id}/evidence/latest/example-lifecycle-records.json
when_provided.3: Detect regressions: any scenario that reached a weaker state than its prior state
when_provided.5: Set prior_run_result and regression_detected on each lifecycle record
when_provided.6: If regression_detected on any record, log warning (non-blocking for now, can be made blocking later)

cli_behavior.when_absent: Existing behavior unchanged. No comparison performed. No new fields set.
cli_behavior.prior_run_not_found: Log error, write comparison artifact with verdict RUN_TO_RUN_COMPARISON_BLOCKED_PRIOR_RUN_NOT_FOUND, continue (non-blocking)

lifecycle_model_changes.backward_compatibility: All new fields have defaults (None or False). Old JSON without these fields will load via dataclass defaults. Existing tests unaffected.

state_strength_ordering.description: State ordering from weakest to strongest, used for regression detection
state_strength_ordering.regression_rule: If prior_strength > current_strength AND no supersession_evidence, then regression_detected=true

comparison_logic.location: New function compare_with_prior_run() added to example_lifecycle.py
comparison_logic.outputs: RunToRunComparisonResult dataclass with per-scenario results and summary
algorithm: 3. Load prior records as list of dicts (not dataclass — forward compatible)
5. For each current record: look up prior. Compare current_stage strength.
6. Classify: UNCHANGED, IMPROVED, REGRESSED, NEW_SCENARIO, MISSING_FROM_CURRENT
7. For scenarios in prior but not current: classify as MISSING_FROM_CURRENT (regression unless excluded/superseded)

runner_integration.location: run_pipeline() in runner.py, after write_lifecycle_evidence() call (line ~1348)
runner_integration.change: If compare_run is provided, call compare_with_prior_run() and write comparison artifact
runner_integration.non_blocking: Comparison result is informational — logged as WARNING if regression found, does not change gate_verdict
runner_integration.future_hardening: Can later be made a hard gate by checking comparison result before report generation

gate_1_result: PASS — design is consistent with current lifecycle model and runner architecture
